children: Aritzia's brand heat, growth runway and strong free cash flow are positive tailwinds that should carry the company in 2Q. TD Cowen analyst Brian Morrison forecasts revenue growth of 39% in the quarter, toward the high-end of company guidance of $1.1 billion to $1.125 billion. "We attribute this to SSSG [same-store sales growth] of 30.4% (consensus 28.8%), driven by brand heat supporting strength across both B&M [brick and mortar] and e-commerce," Morrison says. He notes that management noted mid-quarter that demand accelerated exiting 1Q on strong Spring/Summer demand, and now "we believe has been sustained entering the pre-Fall/Fall launches as per our channel checks/ALTD." (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
